verdict.rationale: Insomnia offers limited natural-language features: generating a mock server from a prompt (insomnia-docs-10, insomnia-docs-29, insomnia-docs-51) and AI commit message suggestions (insomnia-docs-35, insomnia-docs-52), but there is no evidence of a general natural-language command interface for core operations like creating/running requests, tests, or environments. Missing for 10: broad NL command support across the app, evidence of NL-driven request/test execution, independent hands-on validation of the AI features' reliability.
